detail.readme:
ESP32 iPhone Agent

Your AI looks at the iPhone screen, then taps, swipes and types for you,
through a $7 ESP32 board plugged into the phone. No computer, no changes to iOS.

Try on TestFlight · Flash the board · Not a developer? · Watch the demo · Docs · Changelog

Featured on Hackaday · Digital Trends · Ruanyf Weekly #415 · Seeed Studio

English · 简体中文

Follow along: X @iamhenryyuan · Xiaohongshu · YouTube demo · DeepSeek Harness demo · handsy.tech


A real iPhone doing a Duolingo lesson by itself, sped up 8×. Nobody touches the screen.

Building on this project? Keep the LICENSE and credit ESP32 iPhone Agent by Henry Yuan in your README and posts. See NOTICE.

## What's new

- **It hears the phone.** The board forwards AirPlay audio and the iPhone turns it into words, so listening exercises and voice prompts work. [How it works](https://handsy.tech/docs/listen?ref=github). - **Free Jev line.** Jev takes the plain steps in a fraction of a second and leaves the rest to the large model; the agent loop is rebuilt around one model call per step. - **Long tasks.** No 40-step limit; any stopped run can continue. Every run can be replayed step by step on the phone. Get it on [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/1xQHgJcA) (App Store listing in review). Needs board firmware v0.2.4. [Full changelog](https://handsy.tech/docs/changelog?ref=github). ## Why a board Most iPhone agents run on a computer. Before the first task you install Xcode, turn on Developer Mode, pair the phone over USB and type commands into a terminal, and the computer has to stay on for every task after that. Fine for a developer, a wall for everyone else. Here the board does the computer's job, so the phone is all you need. | | **ESP32 iPhone Agent** | Computer-tethered agents
WebDriverAgent, CoreDevice, idevice | |---|---|---| | What you need | **An iPhone and a $7 board** | A Mac (often a recent macOS), full Xcode, developer tools | | Setup | **Flash in the browser, install from TestFlight, four guided steps in the app** | Terminal: clone, build, install dependencies, sign the helper app | | Changes on the iPhone | **AssistiveTouch on (the app walks you through it)** | Developer Mode, USB trust and pairing | | While it runs | **Just the phone. Take it anywhere** | The computer stays on and connected | | Apps it can use | **Any app a person can use: it sees the screen and moves a pointer** | What the debug and accessibility interfaces expose | | Hears the phone | **Yes (App 1.0.2)** | Usually not | The honest costs: you buy a $7 board, each step takes a few seconds (most of it the model), and the phone uses cellular data while it runs because the board's hotspot takes the Wi-Fi. ### Not a developer? Start here 1. **Get the board.** A Seeed XIAO ESP32S3, about $7: [what to buy](https://handsy.tech/docs/hardware?ref=github). 2. **Flash it in Chrome or Edge.** No tools to install: [handsy.tech/install](https://handsy.tech/install?ref=github). 3. **Install the app and follow its four setup steps.** [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/1xQHgJcA) · [setup guide with pictures](https://handsy.tech/esp32-iphone-agent-setup?ref=github). Stuck? See [troubleshooting](https://handsy.tech/troubleshooting?ref=github) or mail [support@handsy.tech](mailto:support@handsy.tech). > [!NOTE] > **Free line busy or failing?** The free model line is shared and can be busy or return errors (HTTP 503) for a > while, so a run may stall or fail every step. Switch to your own API key in Settings › Model to keep going, and > let us know on X: [@iamhenryyuan](https://x.com/iamhenryyuan). ## How it works New to the idea? Start with [AI control for iPhone](https://handsy.tech/ai-control-iphone), then [how Handsy works](https://handsy.tech/how-it-works). ``` iPhone ──Screen Mirroring (Wi-Fi)──▶ ESP32-S3: AirPlay receiver ──Wi-Fi TCP :7201──▶ ESP32 Agent app (same iPhone) ▲ own hotspot, H.264 passthrough decode → vision model → action └──────── USB HID mouse + keyboard ◀──────────── BLE commands ◀──────────────────────┘ ``` - **Eyes — AirPlay to the board.** The board opens its own Wi-Fi hotspot and appears in the phone's Screen Mirroring list as *ESP32 Agent*. It keeps the H.264 stream (no decoding on the board) and forwards it to the app over Wi-Fi (TCP, port 7201). BLE carries commands and status. The phone keeps using cellular data for the model while it is on the board's hotspot. - **Hands — USB HID.** The board is a standard USB mouse and keyboard. With AssistiveTouch on, the mouse moves an on-screen pointer, so a click is a tap and a drag is a swipe. - **Brain — the app.** The app decodes the stream, sends screenshots to any OpenAI-compatible vision model, and runs a planner and an actor: tap, swipe, draw, type, press keys, go home, finish. It runs in the background while it works; the Dynamic Island shows what it is doing. - **Closing the loop.** The pointer is relative, so the app tracks it and re-homes it in a corner; before precise taps it wiggles the pointer, finds it on screen and corrects the miss. After each action it waits for the screen to settle and tells the model whether anything changed. A lost board, hotspot or mirroring link pauses the run and resumes it from the same step. - **Review.** Every run is kept on the phone: replay it step by step with the taps and swipes drawn on top. Export the screenshots, actions and saved annotations from **Runs → open a run → ⋯ → Export trace** for analysis by another agent. See [Export runs for agent review](docs/run-data-export.md) for batch export, USB copying and file details.

*Left: the real phone. Right: what the agent sees through the board's AirPlay mirror. The second shot is the pointer calibration.* The first version (v0.1.0) ran on a Mac/Linux computer with UxPlay and a Python server. It is kept as tag [`v0.1.0`](https://github.com/onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent/tree/v0.1.0) and branch [`legacy`](https://github.com/onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent/tree/legacy); see [docs/legacy.md](docs/legacy.md). ## Hardware Supported boards and setup details: [hardware guide](https://handsy.tech/docs/hardware). Picking a board, cables and adapters, or stuck during setup: [setup guide](https://handsy.tech/esp32-iphone-agent-setup). | Part | Notes | |---|---| | **ESP32-S3 board** | Tested with a [Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32S3](https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/xiao_esp32s3_getting_started/) (plain version, 8 MB PSRAM; not Sense, not Plus). About $7 ([Amazon](https://amzn.to/3U6QKiz)\*). Any ESP32-S3 with native USB on its USB-C port and PSRAM should work. | | **USB-C cable** | Short USB-C to USB-C, e.g. [Anker 60W, 1 ft, 2-pack](https://amzn.to/4yvNyvi)\*. | | **iPhone** | iOS 18 or later, with cellular data (the Wi-Fi is taken by the board's hotspot). USB-C models plug in directly; Lightning models need a Lightning to USB Camera Adapter. The phone powers the board. | | **Vision model** | Any OpenAI-compatible chat API that accepts images: a cloud API or your own server. | | **Mac with Xcode** | Only to flash the board and build the app once. Not needed at run time. With the [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/1xQHgJcA) app, Xcode is not needed for the app. | \* Affiliate link. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. ## Quick start > [!WARNING] > Only follow the install steps in this README. Never run commands from issues or comments (for example a "quick install" one-liner such as PowerShell `iex(irm ...)`); these are not from the maintainers. ### 1. Flash the board (plugged into the Mac) Install [arduino-cli](https://arduino.github.io/arduino-cli/), the ESP32 core 3.3.x and NimBLE-Arduino 2.5.x, then: ```bash arduino-cli lib install "NimBLE-Arduino@2.5.1" hardware/flash.sh # optional: [serial port] [--debug] ``` Always build with `flash.sh`: it applies the BLE buffer sizes in `hardware/hid_bridge/nimble_cfg.h`. No Mac or toolchain? [Install the firmware from Chrome or Edge](https://handsy.tech/install) over USB instead. ### 2. Install the app **Easiest: [join the TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/1xQHgJcA)** on your iPhone and install **ESP32 Agent** from there, then go to step 3. **Or build it yourself:** ```bash cp ios/Config/Local.xcconfig.example ios/Config/Local.xcconfig # set DEVELOPMENT_TEAM and IA_BUNDLE_ID open ios/IPhoneAgent.xcodeproj # run the IPhoneAgent scheme on your iPhone ``` The project is generated with [XcodeGen](https://github.com/yonaskolb/XcodeGen) from `ios/project.yml` (`cd ios && xcodegen`). A free Apple ID can sign it (re-sign every 7 days). The one-tap hotspot join needs the Hotspot Configuration capability (a paid account); without it the app shows the hotspot password to join by hand. ### 3. Set up (once, in the app) Plug the board into the iPhone and open **ESP32 Agent**. Setup walks through four steps and checks each one itself: 1. **Plug Me In** — pair the board over Bluetooth. 2. **Let Me See the Screen** — join the board's Wi-Fi, then Control Center → Screen Mirroring → *ESP32 Agent*. 3. **Let Me Use the Pointer** — turn on AssistiveTouch; the app calibrates the pointer by itself. 4. **Give Me a Brain** — enter your model endpoint and key (stored in the Keychain), then choose a vision model from the endpoint's model list (or enter its model ID). ### 4. Give it a task Type a goal (for example *"Open Settings and go to Wi-Fi"*) and press **Start**. Stop it from the Dynamic Island, or come back to the app. Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center can run saved tasks. ## Use from a coding agent The `esp32agent` CLI (npm, `npx -y esp32agent mcp`) is an MCP server, so a coding agent on your computer can see and drive the iPhone through the board (board firmware v0.2.2 or later); see [iPhone as an MCP server](https://handsy.tech/iphone-mcp). This repository is also a plugin with that MCP server and an agent skill ([skills/handsy/SKILL.md](skills/handsy/SKILL.md)). In Claude Code ([walkthrough](https://handsy.tech/claude-code-iphone)): ```bash /plugin marketplace add onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent /plugin install esp32agent@handsy ``` Or add only the MCP server: ```bash claude mcp add esp32agent -- npx -y esp32agent mcp ``` Cursor, Cline and other MCP clients: ```json { "mcpServers": { "esp32agent": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "esp32agent", "mcp"] } } } ``` DeepSeek Harness (dsh): install the plugin in [integrations/dsh](integrations/dsh/README.md), which adds the same MCP server and skill ([demo video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DzYv0QVk_No)): ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-esp32agent ``` The CLI talks to the board from your computer over Bluetooth, or over your Wi-Fi once both are on it (`esp32agent net join`), so it works without the iPhone app or TestFlight. Commands and options are in the [CLI reference](https://handsy.tech/docs/cli) and [cli/README.md](cli/README.md). ## Model and prompts - Any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint works (vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama, cloud APIs). The app lists the endpoint's models for you to choose one explicitly; you can also enter a model ID, and set a separate planner and actor model. - Settings → Model → Advanced → Extra body JSON is merged into each chat request. DeepSeek's API (`api.deepseek.com`) thinks at high effort unless told otherwise, so the app sends `{"thinking":{"type":"disabled"}}` there unless that JSON already contains `thinking`; use `{"thinking":{"type":"enabled"},"reasoning_effort":"low"}` to keep a little reasoning. - The prompts are plain text in [`prompts/`](prompts/) and bundled with the app: edit them, rebuild, done. - Each finished run logs planner/actor call counts, requests with a screenshot, and token totals when the endpoint reports `usage`. Missing usage is left absent (never coerced to 0); the run total is marked **partial** if any call omitted it. A short task is typically a few planner calls plus one actor call per step — each actor step sends a fresh screenshot — so image tokens dominate cost. Giving the planner a cheaper model while keeping a stronger actor is usually the best tradeoff. - The project was developed with [nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4) served on two DGX Sparks ([TensorFold](https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Dual-DGX-Sparks-TensorFold)). ## Project layout ``` ios/ the app (SwiftUI): BLE link, H.264 decode, agent, setup, replay, Live Activity, widgets; tests prompts/ planner / actor prompts used by the app hardware/ ESP32-S3 firmware (Arduino): BLE GATT, hotspot, AirPlay receiver, USB HID; flash script, host tests, Mac BLE test harness (hardware/tools) docs/ BLE protocol, legacy version notes harness/ wireless development loop: Mac → iPhone app (Wi-Fi install) → board (firmware through the app) server/ legacy v0.1.0 computer-side server; not used by this version (see server/README.md) ``` Debugging without the phone app: `hardware/tools/board_test.py` plays the app over BLE from a Mac ([hardware/tools/README.md](hardware/tools/README.md)). Board ↔ app protocol: [docs/ble-protocol.md](docs/ble-protocol.md). ### Harness development With the board plugged into a test iPhone and the iPhone on the Mac's Wi-Fi, everything goes through `devicectl`, no cable: `harness/app.sh` builds and installs the Debug app, `harness/fw.sh` builds the firmware and copies it into the app, which installs it on the board (rolls back by itself if the new image fails), `harness/run.sh ""` runs a task and `harness/logs.sh` pulls the log. BLE from the Mac is only for the one-time `net sta`. Setup (Lightning iPhones: camera adapter), security: [harness/README.md](harness/README.md). Phone out of reach (e.g. on cellular): the optional, off-by-default [remote debug log](docs/remote-debug-log.md) uploads the app's text log to a server you run. ## Roadmap - [x] Drop the computer: the board mirrors and clicks, the app on the phone thinks - [ ] Landscape apps (coordinates and calibration assume portrait) - [x] Chinese text input (typed as pinyin through the board's keyboard; ctrl+space switches English and pinyin) - [ ] Faster steps: several actions per model call, pointer checks only when needed - [ ] A curated list of models that work best with this setup, shown inside the iOS app ([suggested by @asharthinks](https://x.com/asharthinks/status/2110740775030125019)) ## Limitations - **AirPlay source must be an iPhone.** Screen Mirroring from macOS is not supported: the handshake can look healthy while the board never receives video. - The screen is mirrored at 480×1040, up to 5 fps; each step takes a few seconds, most of it the model. - iOS does not mirror some screens (passcode entry, Apple Pay, DRM video); the agent cannot see them. Mirroring stops when the phone locks. - While the agent runs, the phone's Wi-Fi is the board's hotspot (no internet over it); the model is reached over cellular data. - Chinese is typed as pinyin through the board's keyboard (ctrl+space switches English and pinyin). The clipboard is not used for this; emoji are dropped. Landscape apps are not supported yet. If something doesn't work (no *ESP32 Agent* in Screen Mirroring, the board not connecting), see [troubleshooting](https://handsy.tech/troubleshooting). ## Responsible use Only automate devices and accounts you own or are allowed to use, and respect the terms of the apps involved. The agent acts with your hands: watch it, and keep the stop button within reach. ## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Start from the latest `main` and open pull requests against `main`. Before opening a pull request, update your branch from the latest `main` (fetch and rebase, or merge in the latest `main`). Security reports: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). The latest code is on `main`; [`release-1.0`](https://github.com/onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent/tree/release-1.0) is the version submitted to TestFlight and App Store review, and is no longer the branch for contributions. ## Contact Questions or feedback: [support@handsy.tech](mailto:support@handsy.tech) · Website: [handsy.tech](https://handsy.tech) ## Related projects | Project | Approach | Difference from this project | |---|---|---| | [VersaiOS](https://github.com/zhaodashuaibi/VersaiOS) | UxPlay mirroring + ESP32-S3 Bluetooth mouse + vision model | Needs a computer; one tap per instruction | | [ja1chen/actell](https://github.com/ja1chen/actell) | Agent app on the iPhone via Apple's CoreDevice debug channel | Needs Developer Mode and a Developer Disk Image | | [AidenAI-IO/aiden-firmware](https://github.com/AidenAI-IO/aiden-firmware) | HDMI capture + USB keyboard/mouse + multimodal model | Capture hardware; mainly Android | | [yoyicue/glassbox](https://github.com/yoyicue/glassbox) | PicoKVM HDMI capture + USB HID | macOS controller and PicoKVM | | [boboabw/phone-agent](https://github.com/boboabw/phone-agent) | ESP32-S3 Bluetooth HID + AssistiveTouch, agent as an iPhone app | Closest to this version; this one also brings the eyes (AirPlay on the board) | | [VKCOM/devicehub](https://github.com/VKCOM/devicehub) | ESP32 Bluetooth mouse for iOS device farms | Device-farm tooling, no AI agent | WebDriverAgent/XCUITest-based tools such as [mobile-mcp](https://github.com/mobile-next/mobile-mcp) and [Midscene](https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene) need a Mac and code signing. ## Acknowledgements [UxPlay](https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay) (the AirPlay receiver the firmware's is ported from) · [NimBLE-Arduino](https://github.com/h2zero/NimBLE-Arduino) · [Arduino ESP32 core](https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32) and [TinyUSB](https://github.com/hathach/tinyusb) ## License > **Building on this project?** Keep the [LICENSE](LICENSE) and credit **[ESP32 iPhone Agent by Henry Yuan](https://github.com/onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent)** in your README, demos and posts. See [NOTICE](NOTICE). [MIT](LICENSE), except `hardware/hid_bridge/src/airplay/` (ported from UxPlay), which is [GPL-3.0](hardware/hid_bridge/src/airplay/LICENSE-GPL.md); the firmware binary that links it is therefore distributed under GPL-3.0. Files under [`skills/`](skills/) are [MIT-0](skills/LICENSE) (MIT No Attribution); the rest of the repository keeps the license above. ## Contributors Thanks to everyone who has helped build ESP32 iPhone Agent: [@cy41](https://github.com/cy41) · [@shinjiyu](https://github.com/shinjiyu) · [@Yi-111-a](https://github.com/Yi-111-a) · [@buddyh](https://github.com/buddyh) · [@djs-91](https://github.com/djs-91) · [@EliotAndres](https://github.com/EliotAndres) · [@lukas-1997](https://github.com/lukas-1997) · [@mvanhorn](https://github.com/mvanhorn). Pull requests start from the latest `main`. ## Star History
detail.readme_zh:
ESP32 iPhone Agent

你的 AI 看着 iPhone 屏幕，替你点、滑、打字；
靠的是一块插在手机上、约 40 多元的 ESP32 小板子。不需要电脑，也不用改动 iOS 系统。

在 TestFlight 上试用 · 在浏览器里烧录固件 · 不是开发者？ · 看演示 · 文档 · 更新记录

媒体报道 Hackaday · Digital Trends · 阮一峰《科技爱好者周刊》#415 · Seeed Studio 官方推荐

English · 简体中文

关注更新：X @iamhenryyuan · 小红书 袁老板讲黑客松（Henry） · YouTube 演示 · DeepSeek Harness 演示 · handsy.tech


一台真 iPhone 自己做完一节多邻国课程，8 倍速，全程没人碰屏幕。

基于本项目开发？请保留 LICENSE，并在你的 README 和帖子中注明 ESP32 iPhone Agent by Henry Yuan。详见 NOTICE。

## 最近更新

- **能听到手机的声音。** 板子转发 AirPlay 音频，iPhone 本机转成文字，听力题、语音提示都能处理。[原理](https://handsy.tech/zh/docs/listen?ref=github)。 - **免费的 Jev 线路。** 简单的步骤 Jev 不到一秒就做完，其余交给大模型；Agent loop 也重做了，每步只调一次模型。 - **长任务。** 不再 40 步就停，停下的任务可以接着跑；每次运行都能在手机上逐步回放。 在 [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/1xQHgJcA) 安装（App Store 版本审核中）。需要板子固件 v0.2.4。[完整更新记录](https://handsy.tech/zh/docs/changelog?ref=github)。 ## 为什么用一块板子 大多数 iPhone Agent 都跑在电脑上：第一次用之前要装 Xcode、打开开发者模式、用数据线配对手机、在终端里敲命令；之后每次运行，电脑都得开着、连着。开发者能忍，普通人基本卡在第一步。这里由板子替代电脑，有手机就够了。 | | **ESP32 iPhone Agent** | 依赖电脑的方案
WebDriverAgent、CoreDevice、idevice | |---|---|---| | 需要什么 | **一台 iPhone + 一块 7 美元的板子** | 一台 Mac（通常要较新的 macOS）、完整的 Xcode、开发工具链 | | 怎么装 | **浏览器里烧录固件，TestFlight 装 App，App 里跟着四步走** | 终端里克隆、编译、装依赖、给辅助 App 签名 | | iPhone 上要改什么 | **打开辅助触控（App 会一步步带你开）** | 开发者模式、USB 信任和配对 | | 运行时 | **只要手机，带到哪都能用** | 电脑要一直开着、连着 | | 能用哪些 App | **人能用的都能用：它看屏幕、移动指针** | 调试接口和无障碍接口能拿到的部分 | | 能听到手机的声音 | **能（App 1.0.2）** | 通常不能 | 实话说代价也有：要买一块 7 美元的板子；每一步要几秒，大部分时间花在模型上；运行时手机的 Wi-Fi 被板子热点占用，要用蜂窝数据。 ### 不是开发者？从这里开始 1. **买板子。** Seeed XIAO ESP32S3，约 40 多元：[买什么](https://handsy.tech/zh/docs/hardware?ref=github)。 2. **在 Chrome 或 Edge 里烧录固件。** 不用装任何工具：[handsy.tech/zh/install](https://handsy.tech/zh/install?ref=github)。 3. **安装 App，跟着四步设置走。** [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/1xQHgJcA) · [带图的设置指南](https://handsy.tech/zh/esp32-iphone-agent-setup?ref=github)。 遇到问题？看[常见问题排查](https://handsy.tech/zh/troubleshooting?ref=github)，或发邮件到 [support@handsy.tech](mailto:support@handsy.tech)。 > [!NOTE] > **免费线路繁忙或报错？** 免费模型线路是大家共用的，有时会繁忙或暂时报错（HTTP 503），任务可能卡住、或每一步都失败。 > 这时可以在「设置 › 模型」里换成你自己的 API key 继续用，也欢迎在 X 上告诉作者：[@iamhenryyuan](https://x.com/iamhenryyuan)。 ## 工作原理 第一次接触？先看[让 AI 操控 iPhone](https://handsy.tech/zh/ai-control-iphone)，再看 [Handsy 工作原理](https://handsy.tech/zh/how-it-works)。 ``` iPhone ──屏幕镜像（Wi-Fi）──▶ ESP32-S3：AirPlay 接收端 ──Wi-Fi TCP :7201──▶ ESP32 Agent App（同一台 iPhone） ▲ 自带热点，H.264 原样转发 解码 → 视觉模型 → 动作 └──────── USB HID 鼠标 + 键盘 ◀──────────── 蓝牙命令 ◀────────────────────┘ ``` - **眼睛：AirPlay 投到板子上。** 板子开自己的 Wi-Fi 热点，在手机的「屏幕镜像」里显示为 *ESP32 Agent*。它不解码，只把 H.264 码流经 Wi-Fi（TCP，端口 7201）转给 App。蓝牙传命令和状态。手机连着板子热点时，调用模型走蜂窝数据。 - **手：USB HID。** 板子是标准 USB 鼠标和键盘。打开辅助触控（AssistiveTouch）后，鼠标控制屏幕上的指针，点击就是轻点，拖动就是滑动。 - **大脑：App。** App 解码画面，把截图发给任意兼容 OpenAI 接口的视觉模型，由规划器和执行器决定动作：点、滑、画、输入、按键、回主屏、结束。工作时 App 在后台运行，灵动岛显示它在做什么。 - **闭环。** 指针是相对移动的，App 记录位置并定期回角落归零；精细点击前晃一下指针、在画面里找到它并修正偏差。每个动作后等画面稳定，再告诉模型画面有没有变化。板子、热点或镜像断开时暂停，恢复后从同一步继续。 - **复盘。** 每次运行都存在手机上，可以逐步回放，点按和滑动画在截图上。

*左：真机；右：Agent 通过板子的 AirPlay 镜像看到的画面。第二张是指针校准。* 最初的版本（v0.1.0）用 Mac/Linux 电脑跑 UxPlay + Python 服务端，保留在 tag [`v0.1.0`](https://github.com/onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent/tree/v0.1.0) 和分支 [`legacy`](https://github.com/onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent/tree/legacy)，见 [docs/legacy.md](docs/legacy.md)。 ## 硬件 支持的板子和硬件细节见[硬件指南](https://handsy.tech/zh/docs/hardware)。选板子、线材和转接头，或者设置时卡住了，见[安装设置指南](https://handsy.tech/zh/esp32-iphone-agent-setup)。 | 部件 | 说明 | |---|---| | **ESP32-S3 板子** | 测试用的是 [Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32S3](https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/xiao_esp32s3_getting_started/)（普通版，8 MB PSRAM；不是 Sense，也不是 Plus），淘宝搜 "XIAO ESP32S3"，约 40-50 元；海外可在 [Amazon](https://amzn.to/3U6QKiz)\* 购买。USB-C 口接 S3 原生 USB、带 PSRAM 的 ESP32-S3 板子都应该可以。 | | **USB-C 线** | 短的 USB-C 对 USB-C 线，例如 [Anker 60W，1 英尺，2 条装](https://amzn.to/4yvNyvi)\*。 | | **iPhone** | iOS 18 及以上，需要蜂窝数据（Wi-Fi 被板子热点占用）。USB-C 机型直接插；Lightning 机型需要 Lightning 转 USB 相机转换器。板子由手机供电。 | | **视觉模型** | 任何支持图片输入、兼容 OpenAI 接口的模型：云端 API 或自己部署。 | | **装了 Xcode 的 Mac** | 只在刷板子、编译 App 时用一次，运行时不需要。用 [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/1xQHgJcA) 安装 App 的话，App 这部分不需要 Xcode。 | \* 推广链接。作为亚马逊联盟成员，我会从符合条件的购买中获得佣金。 ## 快速开始 > [!WARNING] > 请只按本 README 的步骤安装。不要运行 issue 或评论里的命令（例如 PowerShell 的 `iex(irm ...)` 之类“快速安装”一行命令），这些都不是维护者发的。 ### 1. 刷板子（插在 Mac 上） 安装 [arduino-cli](https://arduino.github.io/arduino-cli/)、ESP32 core 3.3.x 和 NimBLE-Arduino 2.5.x，然后： ```bash arduino-cli lib install "NimBLE-Arduino@2.5.1" hardware/flash.sh # 可选参数：[串口] [--debug] ``` 一定要用 `flash.sh` 编译：它会带上 `hardware/hid_bridge/nimble_cfg.h` 里的蓝牙缓冲区配置。 没有 Mac 或不想装工具链？也可以用 Chrome 或 Edge 通过 USB [在网页上刷固件](https://handsy.tech/zh/install)。 ### 2. 安装 App **最简单：在 iPhone 上[加入 TestFlight 测试](https://testflight.apple.com/join/1xQHgJcA)**，从那里安装 **ESP32 Agent**，然后直接看第 3 步。 **或者自己编译：** ```bash cp ios/Config/Local.xcconfig.example ios/Config/Local.xcconfig # 填 DEVELOPMENT_TEAM 和 IA_BUNDLE_ID open ios/IPhoneAgent.xcodeproj # 在 iPhone 上运行 IPhoneAgent scheme ``` 工程由 [XcodeGen](https://github.com/yonaskolb/XcodeGen) 从 `ios/project.yml` 生成（`cd ios && xcodegen`）。免费 Apple ID 就能签名（每 7 天重签一次）。一键加入热点需要 Hotspot Configuration 能力（付费账号）；没有的话 App 会显示热点密码让你手动加入。 ### 3. 首次设置（在 App 里） 把板子插到 iPhone 上，打开 **ESP32 Agent**。引导共四步，每一步 App 自己检测： 1. **Plug Me In**：蓝牙配对板子。 2. **Let Me See the Screen**：加入板子的 Wi-Fi，然后 控制中心 → 屏幕镜像 → *ESP32 Agent*。 3. **Let Me Use the Pointer**：打开辅助触控，App 自动校准指针。 4. **Give Me a Brain**：填模型地址和密钥（存在钥匙串里），再从接口的模型列表里选一个视觉模型（或自己填模型 ID）。 ### 4. 给它一个任务 输入目标（比如 *"打开设置，进入无线局域网"*），点 **Start**。可以从灵动岛停止，或回到 App 停止。Siri、快捷指令、小组件和控制中心可以运行保存的任务。 ## 在编程 Agent 里使用 `esp32agent` 命令行（npm，`npx -y esp32agent mcp`）是一个 MCP 服务器，电脑上的编程 Agent 可以通过板子看到并操作 iPhone（板子固件需 v0.2.2 或更高），见[把 iPhone 变成 MCP 服务器](https://handsy.tech/zh/iphone-mcp)。本仓库也是一个插件，包含这个 MCP 服务器和一个 Agent 技能（[skills/handsy/SKILL.md](skills/handsy/SKILL.md)）。在 Claude Code 里（[使用教程](https://handsy.tech/zh/claude-code-iphone)）： ```bash /plugin marketplace add onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent /plugin install esp32agent@handsy ``` 或者只添加 MCP 服务器： ```bash claude mcp add esp32agent -- npx -y esp32agent mcp ``` Cursor、Cline 等 MCP 客户端： ```json { "mcpServers": { "esp32agent": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "esp32agent", "mcp"] } } } ``` DeepSeek Harness（dsh）：安装 [integrations/dsh](integrations/dsh/README.md) 里的插件，同样包含这个 MCP 服务器和技能（[演示视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DzYv0QVk_No)）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-esp32agent ``` 命令行工具在电脑上通过蓝牙直接连板子，板子和电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi 后改走 Wi-Fi（`esp32agent net join`），不需要 iPhone App，也不需要 TestFlight。命令和参数见[命令行文档](https://handsy.tech/zh/docs/cli)和 [cli/README.md](cli/README.md)。 ## 模型和提示词 - 任何兼容 OpenAI 接口的视觉模型都能用（vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp、Ollama、云端 API）。App 会列出接口上的模型，由你明确选一个；也可以自己填模型 ID，规划器和执行器可以用不同模型。 - 设置 → 模型 → 高级 → Extra body JSON 会合并进每次聊天请求。DeepSeek 的 API（`api.deepseek.com`）默认以高强度思考，所以 App 会发送 `{"thinking":{"type":"disabled"}}`，除非这段 JSON 里已经有 `thinking`；想保留少量推理可填 `{"thinking":{"type":"enabled"},"reasoning_effort":"low"}`。 - 提示词是 [`prompts/`](prompts/) 里的纯文本，打包进 App：改完重新编译即可。 - 每次运行结束会记录规划器/执行器调用次数、带截图的请求数，以及接口返回的 token 用量。接口没给 `usage` 时字段保持空缺（不会当成 0）；只要有一次缺用量，本次合计就标成 **partial**。短任务一般是几次规划 + 每步一次执行（每步带一张新截图），成本主要在图片 token；规划器用便宜模型、执行器保留更强模型通常最划算。 - 开发时用的是 [nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4)，部署在两台 DGX Spark 上（[TensorFold](https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Dual-DGX-Sparks-TensorFold)）。 ## 目录结构 ``` ios/ App（SwiftUI）：蓝牙连接、H.264 解码、Agent、引导、回放、实时活动、小组件；单元测试 prompts/ App 用的规划器 / 执行器提示词 hardware/ ESP32-S3 固件（Arduino）：蓝牙 GATT、热点、AirPlay 接收端、USB HID；刷写脚本、 主机测试、Mac 蓝牙调试工具（hardware/tools） docs/ 蓝牙协议、旧版说明 harness/ 无线开发闭环：Mac → iPhone App（Wi-Fi 安装）→ 板子（固件经 App 更新） server/ 旧版 v0.1.0 的电脑端服务，当前版本不使用（见 server/README.md） ``` 不用手机 App 调试：`hardware/tools/board_test.py` 在 Mac 上通过蓝牙扮演 App（[hardware/tools/README.md](hardware/tools/README.md)）。板子与 App 的协议：[docs/ble-protocol.md](docs/ble-protocol.md)。 ### Harness 开发流程 板子插在测试 iPhone 上、iPhone 连着 Mac 的 Wi-Fi 时，一切都走 `devicectl`，不用线：`harness/app.sh` 编译并安装 Debug 版 App，`harness/fw.sh` 编译固件并拷进 App，由 App 装到板子上（新镜像起不来会自动回滚）， `harness/run.sh "<任务>"` 跑任务，`harness/logs.sh` 拉取日志。Mac 只在一次性 `net sta` 时用蓝牙连板子。 设置（Lightning iPhone 需相机转接器）和安全说明见 [harness/README.md](harness/README.md)。 手机不在身边（例如用蜂窝网络）时：可选、默认关闭的[远程调试日志](docs/remote-debug-log.zh-CN.md)会把 App 的文本日志上传到你自己部署的服务器。 ## 路线图 - [x] 去掉电脑：板子负责镜像和点击，手机上的 App 负责思考 - [ ] 横屏 App（坐标和校准目前按竖屏） - [x] 中文输入（通过板子的键盘按拼音输入；ctrl+space 切换英文和拼音） - [ ] 更快：一次模型调用多个动作，只在需要时校正指针 - [ ] 在 iOS App 内整理一份效果最好的模型推荐列表（[@asharthinks 的建议](https://x.com/asharthinks/status/2110740775030125019)） ## 限制 - **AirPlay 源必须是 iPhone。** 不支持从 macOS 屏幕镜像：握手看起来正常，但板子收不到视频。 - 镜像画面为 480×1040、最高 5 fps；每一步要几秒，主要花在模型上。 - iOS 不镜像部分界面（输入密码、Apple Pay、DRM 视频），Agent 看不到。手机锁屏后镜像会停止。 - Agent 运行时，手机的 Wi-Fi 是板子的热点（没有外网），模型走蜂窝数据。 - 中文通过板子的键盘按拼音输入（ctrl+space 在英文和拼音之间切换），不用剪贴板；emoji 会被丢掉。暂不支持横屏 App。 遇到问题（「屏幕镜像」里找不到 *ESP32 Agent*、板子连不上），见[故障排查](https://handsy.tech/zh/troubleshooting)。 ## 负责任地使用 只自动化你拥有或有权使用的设备和账号，遵守相关 App 的条款。Agent 是在用你的手操作：看着它，随时准备停止。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎提 Issue 和 PR，见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。请从最新的 `main` 开分支，并把 PR 的目标设为 `main`。 开 PR 前先更新到最新的 `main`（fetch 后 rebase，或并入最新的 `main`）。安全问题：[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。 最新代码在 `main`；[`release-1.0`](https://github.com/onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent/tree/release-1.0) 是提交 TestFlight 和 App Store 审核的版本，已不再作为贡献分支。 ##
